title: BiocatalystIdentity
description: Core identifying information and molecular characteristics of the biocatalyst enzyme.

catalyzed_reaction.title: catalyzed_reaction
catalyzed_reaction.description: Description of the specific reaction or type of reaction catalyzed by this enzyme.

ec_number.title: ec_number
ec_number.description: The Enzyme Commission (EC) number that classifies the enzyme according to the reaction it catalyzes.

molecular_weight.title: molecular_weight
molecular_weight.description: The molecular weight of the enzyme in the specified units.

molecular_weight_unit.title: molecular_weight_unit
molecular_weight_unit.description: The unit of measurement for the molecular weight (e.g., kDa, Da).

name.title: name
name.description: The name of the biocatalyst, which can be the trivial name, systematic name, or trade name.

origin_organism.title: origin_organism
origin_organism.description: The organism from which the enzyme was originally derived or isolated.

posttranslational_modification.title: posttranslational_modification
posttranslational_modification.description: Any post-translational modifications present on the enzyme that may affect its activity or properties.

production_organism.title: production_organism
production_organism.description: The organism used to produce the enzyme (may differ from origin organism for recombinant enzymes).

sequences.title: sequences
sequences.description: Amino acid and/or DNA sequence information for the enzyme.

SequenceInfo.title: SequenceInfo
SequenceInfo.description: Sequence information for the biocatalyst at both the protein and nucleic acid levels.

sequence_amino_acid.title: sequence_amino_acid
sequence_amino_acid.description: The amino acid sequence of the enzyme in single-letter code format.

sequence_dna.title: sequence_dna
sequence_dna.description: The DNA sequence encoding the enzyme.
